message.content:
Based on the screenshot provided, here is the detailed description of the YouTube subscriptions feed:

**1) Feed Status:**
The feed **shows video cards**, but it appears to be a **degraded or "Live-only" state**. It is not completely empty, but it only displays a small number of live streams rather than a full grid of mixed content (VODs, Shorts, etc.).

**2) Card Anatomy & Layout:**
*   **Layout:** The cards are arranged in a **horizontal row** (or a very sparse grid with one row visible). There are exactly **3 video cards** displayed under the "Latest" header.
*   **Card Anatomy:**
    *   **Thumbnail/Avatar Area:** On the left of each card is a circular placeholder (white circle with a red outline). Inside or overlapping this circle is a red **"LIVE"** badge.
    *   **Title:** To the right of the avatar, there is a bold video title (e.g., "DIRECT : Le pape Léon XIV est arrivé..."). The titles appear to be truncated with ellipses ("...").
    *   **Channel Name:** Below the title in grey text (e.g., "franceinfo", "FRANCE 24").
    *   **Meta Data:** To the right of the channel name, there is metadata. For live videos, this shows viewer count/time (e.g., "1.5K watching", "3 2 min ago"). For the third card, which might be a recent upload or ended stream, it shows view count and time ("185 9 min ago").
    *   **Duration/Badge:** 
        *   The first card has a red **"LIVE"** pill badge floating near the top right of the text area.
        *   The second and third cards have a dark grey timestamp box in the top right corner showing **"2:01"** and **"4:34"** respectively.

**3) Chips/Toggles at Top:**
*   **Header:** The main heading is **"Latest"**.
*   **Toggle:** On the far right of the header row, there is a chip/toggle button labeled **"All subscriptions"**.

**4) Left Rail Sections:**
The left sidebar (navigation rail) is fully visible and contains:
*   **Main Navigation:** Home, Shorts.
*   **Subscriptions Section (Expanded):** This section is highlighted with a light grey background. It lists specific subscribed channels vertically:
    *   Les Vidéos de Ril...
    *   Marques Brownl...
    *   LastWeekTonight
    *   Hasan Minhaj
    *   Jimmy Kimmel L...
    *   Bloomberg Origi...
    *   Mastar
    *   "Show more" link at the bottom of the list.
*   **Footer Links:** About, Press, Copyright, Contact us, Creators, Advertise, Developers, Terms, Privacy, Policy & Safety, How YouTube works, Test new features, and the copyright text "© 2026 Google LLC".

**5) Empty/Degraded State Details:**
While not strictly empty, the feed looks like a **"Low Content" or "Live Only" state**. Below the single row of live videos, there is a large white space followed by a header that says **"Most relevant"**, but no videos are rendered underneath it yet (or they are below the fold). There is also a **"Show more"** button centered at the very bottom of the page, suggesting the user can load additional content.
